label: preparing
what: Likely coordinated preparations for a concealed gathering or occasion in the great hall at eighteen hundred, involving lighting, tables and possibly bread. The mayor knew of an approved lighting/table inspection, but the underlying purpose was not disclosed in this record. Builder and Freight are most strongly implicated; neighbour appears to knowingly assist with timing and escorting the mayor, and innkeeper and baker plausibly assist with lantern payment and food, though their knowledge of the concealed purpose is less certain. No specific celebration or motive is established; secretary's knowing involvement is unsupported.
